prayer: Lord Jesus, you leave us your peace, not as the world gives. Let {name} receive your peace as a gift, deep and lasting. Let this little heart not be troubled or afraid. Let my heart rest too. When our home feels unsettled, let your peace settle over it like a warm blanket over a sleeping child. Amen.

verse: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places…
prayer: Father, you promise your people a peaceful home, secure dwellings and quiet resting places. Let our home be one of those for {name}. Let it be safe, calm and secure, a place to rest and be at peace. Bless every room where {name} sleeps, plays and is held. Make this house a resting place for everyone who enters it. Amen.

verse: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
prayer: Lord of peace, give {name} peace at all times and in every way. In the morning and at bedtime, in health and in sickness, at home and away. Be with {name} always. Let your peace be the constant thread running through this little life, holding everything together when other things come apart. Amen.

verse: “I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
prayer: Lord Jesus, you told us that in this world we will have trouble, but to take heart, because you have overcome the world. I cannot shield {name} from every trouble, much as I want to. But I can trust that you have already overcome. Let {name} grow up courageous and at peace, knowing who has the final word. Amen.

verse: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
prayer: Father, a child was born to us and a Son was given, called Wonderful Counsellor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace. Thank you that Jesus came as a baby, small and dependent like {name}. Let {name} come to know Jesus as counsellor, strength, father and peace. Let the Prince of Peace reign in our home and in this little heart, today and always. Amen.

verse: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
prayer: Lord, great peace belongs to those who love your law, and nothing makes them stumble. Let {name} love your word and find great peace in it. As this little one begins to explore, let your truth be a steady path underfoot. Keep {name} from stumbling, and let peace follow wherever this child goes. Amen.

verse: As newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow…
prayer: Father, like newborn babies long for milk, let {name} long for the pure spiritual milk of your word, and grow by it. I see how eagerly {name} feeds and grows. Let this child be just as eager for you, hungry for your truth and growing strong in faith. Feed {name} body and soul today. Amen.

verse: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
prayer: Lord, let {name} grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. As this little body grows taller each week, let this little soul grow too, in grace, in understanding and in love for you. To you be the glory for every inch of growth, both now and forever. Amen.

verse: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
prayer: Father, from the fullness of Christ we have all received grace upon grace. Let {name} receive that overflowing grace, wave after wave, like a tide that keeps coming in. Let this child never run out of your kindness. And let my parenting be full of grace too, given freely, again and again, to this little one. Amen.

verse: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast.
prayer: Lord, by grace we are saved through faith, and this is not our own doing; it is your gift, not a reward for works. Let {name} grow up resting in grace, not anxious to earn your love. Let this little one know that being loved by you is a gift, freely given. Free me from trying to earn it too. Amen.

verse: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
prayer: Father, you are able to make all grace abound to us, so that we have everything we need and can abound in every good work. Make your grace abound in our home. Give me all I need to care for {name} today: patience, energy, wisdom and joy. Let grace overflow from us to others. Amen.

verse: But speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ…
prayer: Lord, let {name} grow up in every way into Christ, speaking the truth in love. Let this child learn both truth and love from the start, never one without the other. Help me to model that balance: honest and kind, clear and gentle. Let our family grow together into Christ, the head of everything. Amen.

verse: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
prayer: Father, thank you that we can come boldly to your throne of grace to receive mercy and find help in our time of need. I come boldly today for {name}. We need mercy and help in so many small and big ways. Thank you that your throne is a throne of grace, always open to us. Amen.

verse: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
prayer: Lord, each of us has received a gift to serve others, as good stewards of your grace. You have placed gifts in {name}, some I can already see and many I cannot yet. Help me to recognise and nurture them. Let {name} grow up using every gift to serve others and to make your grace known. Amen.

verse: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
prayer: Father, to each one of us grace was given according to the measure of Christ’s gift. Thank you for the grace you have measured out to {name}: a unique personality, unique gifts and a unique path. Let this child grow up confident in being made just right, with the grace needed for every task ahead. Amen.

verse: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
prayer: Lord, there are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit. Whatever gifts {name} has, let this little one use them with your Spirit and for your glory. Keep {name} from comparing with others. Let this child be glad of both personal gifts and the gifts of others, rejoicing in the variety you have made. Amen.

verse: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
prayer: Father, you love a cheerful giver. Let {name} grow up generous, giving gladly, not grudgingly. Let our home be a generous place, with an open door, a shared table and open hands. Teach me to give cheerfully, so {name} sees generosity as a joy and not a duty. Thank you for giving so generously to us. Amen.

verse: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
prayer: Lord, you have called us to freedom, not to serve ourselves but to serve one another in love. Let {name} use the freedom you give to love and serve others. Even as a little one, this child is teaching me to serve. Let our family be marked by humble, joyful service, in the small things as well as the big. Amen.

verse: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men…
prayer: Father, whatever we do, let us do it heartily, as for you and not for people. Let me care for {name} wholeheartedly, as an act of worship to you: the washing, the feeding, the rocking and the walks. Let {name} grow up seeing that everyday work done with love is precious in your eyes. Amen.

verse: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.”
prayer: Lord Jesus, you call your people the light of the world, a city on a hill that cannot be hidden. Let {name}’s light shine brightly and never be hidden away. Let this little one grow up unashamed of goodness and faith, bringing light into classrooms and playgrounds, workplaces and homes, and into every dark corner where a little kindness is needed. Amen.

verse: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
prayer: Father, a gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger. Help me to answer {name} gently, especially when I am tired and the crying goes on. Let my words calm, not inflame. And as {name} learns to speak, let gentle words become a natural habit in this little mouth too. Amen.

verse: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
prayer: Lord, gracious words are like a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healthy for the body. Let our home be full of sweet, gracious words: words of love, encouragement and praise. Let {name} hear words that build up, heal and bless. Fill my mouth with honey today, and let my child grow strong on kindness. Amen.

verse: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
prayer: Father, let no harmful talk come out of our mouths, but only what is good for building others up, giving grace to those who hear. Let {name} hear only words that build up in our home. Guard my tongue, especially in stress. Let my words to {name}, and about {name}, always give grace. Amen.

verse: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
prayer: Lord, let our speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so we know how to answer everyone. Teach {name}, as words begin to form, to speak with grace and good sense. Help me to model kind, wise and honest speech. Let our home be a school of good words, gently taught. Amen.

verse: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
prayer: Father, anxiety weighs down the heart, but a kind word cheers it up. Thank you for every kind word others have spoken to me as a tired parent. Let me speak kind words to others in return. And let {name} grow up with a cheerful heart, often lifted by kind words, and quick to speak them too. Amen.

verse: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
prayer: Lord, let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, my rock and my redeemer. Let my words to {name} today please you. Let my inner thoughts about this little one be loving, hopeful and true. Make my heart and mouth a blessing to my child. Amen.

verse: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
prayer: Father, the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control. Grow this fruit in me as a parent, and grow it in {name} as the years go by. Let our home be an orchard of your Spirit, where every season brings new fruit for others to enjoy. Amen.

verse: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
prayer: Lord, help us to be kind to one another, tender-hearted, forgiving each other as you in Christ forgave us. Let our home be kind and tender. Let forgiveness be quick and grudges short. Let {name} grow up in a household where kindness is normal and grace is given freely, again and again. Amen.

verse: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.”
prayer: Lord Jesus, you taught us to treat others as we would like them to treat us. Let {name} learn this golden rule from the very start. Let this little one see it lived out in our home: in how we speak, share, forgive and help. Make our family known for treating everyone the way we hope to be treated. Amen.

verse: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another…
prayer: Father, let us love one another with brotherly affection and outdo one another in showing honour. Let our family compete in kindness. Let {name} grow up in a home where everyone tries to honour the others first. Teach this little one warm affection for siblings, cousins, friends and all your people. Amen.

verse: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
prayer: Lord, let steadfast love and faithfulness never leave {name}. Let this child bind them like a necklace around the neck and write them on the tablet of the heart. Let kindness and truth be part of who {name} is, not just things {name} does. Begin writing them on this little heart today. Amen.

verse: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.’”
prayer: Father, you call us to judge fairly and to show kindness and mercy to one another. Let {name} grow up just and kind, fair to everyone and merciful to the weak. Let this child stand up for what is right, gently and bravely. Let our home be a place where justice and kindness walk hand in hand. Amen.

verse: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’”
prayer: Lord Jesus, whatever we do for the least of your brothers and sisters, we do for you. Let {name} grow up with eyes to see the least, the lonely and the overlooked. Let this little one show kindness to those who cannot repay it. And let me model that kind of love in front of {name}. Amen.

verse: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
prayer: Father, your steadfast love toward us is great, and your faithfulness endures forever. Praise you! When I think of all your kindness to our family through {name}, my heart overflows. Let {name} grow up praising you for your great love. Let our home be loud with thanks for your faithful kindness. Amen.

verse: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
prayer: Lord, I have hidden your word in my heart so that I might not sin against you. Let {name} hide your word in this little heart too. Let scripture become a treasure stored deep inside. As I read and sing your words over {name}, let them take root and protect this child for life. Amen.

verse: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
prayer: Father, help me to teach your words to {name}, talking about them when we sit at home, when we walk outside, when we lie down and when we rise. Let your word be part of our everyday conversation, not just special occasions. Let {name} grow up surrounded by your truth in every moment. Amen.

verse: “The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
prayer: Lord, the grass withers and the flowers fade, but your word stands forever. Everything around us changes: {name} is outgrowing clothes every month. But your word stays the same. Let {name} build on that unchanging foundation. When everything else shifts, let this little one stand firm on your eternal word. Amen.

verse: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
prayer: Father, how sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth. As {name} discovers new tastes and textures in these first foods, let this little one also discover the sweetness of your word. Let scripture be something {name} delights in, not a duty but a joy. Amen.

verse: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
prayer: Lord, let the word of Christ dwell richly in our home, teaching and encouraging one another with psalms, hymns and spiritual songs, singing with thankfulness. Fill our home with songs of faith. Let {name} grow up humming hymns and singing praise. Let your word live richly in every corner of our family life. Amen.

verse: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
prayer: Lord Jesus, you said that we do not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God. As I feed {name} with milk and new foods, let me also feed this little one with your word. Let {name} grow strong on both kinds of food, body and soul nourished well. Amen.

verse: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
prayer: Father, your law is perfect, reviving the soul; your testimony is sure, making wise the simple. Let your word revive {name}’s soul throughout life, on bright days and on heavy ones. Let this little one grow wise through your instruction. When {name} feels weary or confused, let your perfect word bring new life, clear direction and a steady heart. Amen.

verse: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
prayer: Father, if I, with all my faults, know how to give good gifts to {name}, how much more will you give good things to those who ask you. I ask today: give {name} good things. Not every toy or treat, but the gifts that truly matter: health, friendship, faith and joy. Thank you for being a better parent than I could ever be, and for teaching me how to give. Amen.

verse: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
prayer: Lord, you are a sun and a shield; you give grace and glory, and you withhold no good thing from those who walk uprightly. Shine on {name} like the morning sun through the window, and shield this little one from harm. Let grace be poured out on our home. Whatever is truly good for {name}, I trust you not to hold it back. Amen.

verse: Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
prayer: Lord, you are {name}’s shepherd, and this little one shall not lack anything that is truly needed. When I worry about money, about providing, about having enough, remind me who our shepherd is. You have provided milk and warmth, clothes and care, all this year. Keep shepherding us. Let {name} grow up knowing the Good Shepherd by name. Amen.

verse: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
prayer: Father, you will supply every need of ours according to your riches in glory in Christ Jesus. You know exactly what {name} needs: the next size of clothes, the right food, the right help at the right time. You also know what I need. Supply it, Lord, from your endless riches, and let me trust you instead of panicking. Amen.

verse: Who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
prayer: Lord, you satisfy us with good things, so that our youth is renewed like the eagle’s. Satisfy {name} with good things today: good food, good sleep, good play and good love. And renew my strength too, so that I can keep up with this little explorer who now crawls into every corner of the house. Amen.

verse: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
prayer: Father, you did not spare your own Son but gave your Son up for us all. How will you not also, along with Jesus, graciously give us everything we need? If you gave your most precious gift for {name}, I can trust you with all the rest: health, provision, protection and the years ahead. Let {name} grow up overwhelmed by the generosity of your love. Amen.

verse: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
prayer: Lord, thanks be to you for your indescribable gift. Some things are too big for words: your love in Jesus, and the gift of {name} in my arms. I cannot describe how full my heart is. So I simply say thank you, and let my life of gratitude say the rest. Amen.

verse: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand. The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
prayer: Lord, you are {name}’s keeper and shade at the right hand. The sun will not strike this little one by day, nor the moon by night. Keep {name} through every hour: through sunny walks and cool evenings, bright mornings and deep nights. Let this child live under your shade, protected and refreshed. Amen.

verse: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
prayer: Father, you hem {name} in, behind and before, and you lay your hand upon this little one. As {name} starts to move and explore and pull up on the furniture, I cannot be everywhere at once. But you are behind and before and all around. Let your hand rest on {name} today and every day. Amen.

verse: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
prayer: Lord, even though we walk through the darkest valley, we will fear no evil, for you are with us; your rod and your staff comfort us. I pray {name} will not face many dark valleys, but if they come, be there. Comfort this little one with your presence. Walk beside us through every shadow. Amen.

verse: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
prayer: Father, when {name} passes through the waters, you will be there; through the rivers, they will not overwhelm; through the fire, this little one will not be burned. You do not promise there will be no hard things, but that you will be with us in them. Thank you for that promise for my child. Amen.

verse: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea, even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
prayer: Lord, if {name} takes the wings of the morning and settles at the farthest limits of the sea, even there your hand will lead and your right hand will hold this little one. Wherever {name} goes in life, near or far, you will be there. Let that comfort me as I watch my child grow toward independence. Amen.

verse: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
prayer: Father, I have set you always before me; because you are at my right hand, I shall not be shaken. Let {name} grow up setting you always before every plan and decision. Be at this little one’s right hand. When life shakes, let {name} stand firm, because you are close. Amen.

verse: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy…
prayer: Lord, you are able to keep {name} from stumbling and to present this little one before your glory with great joy. As {name} starts to stand and wobble and take hold of the sofa, I think of all the stumbles ahead. Keep {name} from stumbling in every way, and present this child joyfully before you one day. Amen.

verse: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
prayer: Lord, you make us lie down in green pastures and lead us beside still waters. Lead {name} to green and peaceful places. Let this little one rest in your good pastures, safe and fed. On the busy days, lead our family beside still waters, where we can breathe, rest and be restored together. Amen.

verse: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
prayer: Father, you restore our souls and lead us in paths of righteousness for your name’s sake. Restore my soul today; I am running low. Lead {name} in right paths, step by step. Let this child grow up walking the paths you choose, and let our family honour your name in how we live. Amen.

verse: And Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
prayer: Lord, you will guide us continually and satisfy us in dry places. You make us like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail. Make {name} like that: flourishing, fresh and full of life. And in my own dry seasons as a parent, satisfy me with your presence and refresh me again. Amen.

verse: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
prayer: Father, as a deer longs for streams of water, so my soul longs for you. Let {name} grow up with that longing for you. Let this child thirst for you more than anything else, and find in you the water that truly satisfies. Make my own thirst for you real and visible, so {name} can see it. Amen.

verse: “But whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
prayer: Lord Jesus, whoever drinks the water you give will never be thirsty again; it becomes a spring welling up to eternal life. Give {name} that living water. Let it well up inside this little one, a constant source of life and joy. Let {name} never go thirsty for meaning, love or hope. Amen.

verse: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
prayer: Father, with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light. Let {name} drink from your fountain of life every day. Let this little one see the world in your light: its beauty, its brokenness and your goodness through it all. Be the source and the light of {name}’s life. Amen.

verse: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
prayer: Lord, there is a river whose streams make glad the city of God. Let that river of your presence flow through our home and make it glad. Let {name} grow up near the streams of your joy. When our house feels dry or tense, let your river bring gladness back again. Amen.

verse: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you are the vine and we are the branches. Whoever abides in you bears much fruit, for apart from you we can do nothing. Let {name} abide in you, connected and fruitful. And let me stay close to you as a parent, because I cannot do this without you. Amen.

verse: That you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God…
prayer: Father, let {name} walk in a manner worthy of you, fully pleasing to you, bearing fruit in every good work and growing in the knowledge of you. Let this little life bear good fruit: kindness, joy, faith and love. And let {name} keep growing in knowing you, year after year. Amen.

verse: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
prayer: Lord, every healthy tree bears good fruit. Make {name} healthy from the roots up: a good heart, good character and good habits. Let the fruit of this little life be good for everyone who meets this child. Help me to tend the roots now, so the fruit will be good later. Amen.

verse: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
prayer: Father, fill {name} with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to your glory and praise. Let this child’s life be full of good things that point to you. Let others see the fruit in {name} and give you the praise. Begin growing that fruit now, small and green but real. Amen.

verse: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you chose us and appointed us to go and bear fruit that will last. You have chosen {name}, too, long before this little one could choose anything. Let {name} bear fruit that lasts, not just successes that fade with time. Let this young life produce love, faith and goodness that endure, blessing people for generations after us. Amen.

verse: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green…
prayer: Father, you promise that the righteous will still bear fruit in old age, full of sap and green. I pray {name} will have a long, fruitful life, still bearing fruit when old and grey-haired. Let this child flourish in every season, from these early days to the very last. Amen.

verse: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
prayer: Lord, the wisdom from above is pure, peaceable, gentle, open to reason, full of mercy and good fruits. Give {name} that heavenly wisdom. Let this little one grow up gentle, reasonable, merciful and sincere. Let wisdom from you produce good fruit in {name}’s life, and in mine as I parent. Amen.

verse: “Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
prayer: Lord, you command us to be strong and courageous, not frightened or dismayed, for you are with us wherever we go. As {name} begins to venture out from my arms, crawling off to explore, give this little one courage. And give me courage to let {name} explore, knowing you go along. Amen.

verse: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
prayer: Father, you have not given us a spirit of fear but of power, love and self-control. Let {name} grow up with that spirit: brave, loving and steady. Free this little one from fear. And free me from the fearful thoughts that sometimes rule my parenting. Replace them with your power, love and calm. Amen.

verse: “Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
prayer: Lord, you tell us to be strong and courageous and not to fear, because you go with us and will never leave or forsake us. Let {name} never feel abandoned. Even when I step out of the room and this little one cries for me, let {name} learn that love comes back. You never leave at all. Amen.

verse: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
prayer: Father, help us to wait for you; to be strong and let our hearts take courage; to wait for you. Waiting is hard, for sleep, for milestones, for answers to prayers. Give {name} and me courage as we wait. Let our hearts be strong and hopeful, trusting your perfect timing. Amen.

verse: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
prayer: Lord, you hold {name}’s right hand and say, do not fear, I will help you. As this little hand grips mine, let me remember that you hold us both. Let {name} grow up holding your hand, unafraid, knowing that help is always near. Thank you for being the God who helps. Amen.

verse: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong! Let all that you do be done in love.
prayer: Father, help us to be watchful, to stand firm in faith, to be courageous and strong, and to let all we do be done in love. Let {name} grow up firm in faith and brave in spirit, but always loving. Let courage and love go together in this little life, and in mine. Amen.

verse: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
prayer: Lord, let all who hope in you be strong and take courage. I hope in you for {name}’s future, health and faith. Make my heart strong as I hope. Let {name} grow up hoping in you too, and let that hope give this little one courage for every challenge ahead. Amen.

verse: Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
prayer: Father, I cast all my anxieties on you, because you care for me. I give you my worries about {name}: health, development, safety, the future. You care for this little one even more than I do. Take my anxiety and give me peace. Let {name} grow up seeing a parent who trusts you. Amen.

verse: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
prayer: Lord, I cast my burden on you, and you will sustain me; you will never let the righteous be moved. My burden today is heavy: tired body, worried mind and a crying baby. I put it in your hands. Sustain me. Keep me steady, so I can keep {name} steady too. Amen.

verse: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
prayer: Lord Jesus, you point us to the birds of the air: they do not sow or reap or store away in barns, and yet our heavenly Father feeds them. Are we not worth more than they? {name} is worth so much more. Feed this little one, care for this child and let me stop worrying about every tomorrow. Amen.

verse: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you tell us not to worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own. Help me live today with {name}: this nap, this meal, this cuddle. Free me from borrowing tomorrow’s worries. Let us enjoy the gift of today together. Amen.

verse: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
prayer: Father, when the cares of my heart are many, your comforts cheer my soul. My heart has many cares about {name} today. Come with your comfort. Let your presence cheer my soul and steady my mind. Let {name} feel that comfort too, through my calmer spirit and gentle arms. Amen.

verse: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
prayer: Lord, when I am afraid, I put my trust in you. I am afraid sometimes: of illness, of accidents, of not being enough for {name}. When fear comes, I choose to trust you. Let {name} grow up knowing that fear is not the end of the story. Trust in you is stronger. Amen.

verse: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
prayer: Father, I sought you, and you answered me and delivered me from all my fears. Thank you for answered prayers this year, for times you calmed my fears about {name}. Keep delivering me. Let {name} grow up knowing that you answer those who seek you, and that you free us from fear. Amen.

verse: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
prayer: Lord, one generation commends your works to another and declares your mighty acts. Let our generation tell {name} what you have done for us. Let me tell stories of your faithfulness, so that {name} can tell them to the next generation. Let your praise flow down through our family line like a river. Amen.

verse: Having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
prayer: Father, thank you for the sincere faith that lived first in Lois and Eunice and then in Timothy. Let faith live in our family the same way, passed from grandparents to parents to {name}. Thank you for the people of faith who came before us. Let {name} carry that faith forward, real and sincere. Amen.

verse: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
prayer: Lord, we will not hide from our children the glorious deeds of the Lord and your might. We will tell the next generation. Let me tell {name} about your wonders: creation, rescue and love. Let our home be full of stories of what you have done, so {name} grows up amazed by you. Amen.

verse: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments…
prayer: Father, you are the faithful God, keeping your covenant and steadfast love to a thousand generations of those who love you. A thousand generations, Lord! Let {name} be one link in that long chain of faithfulness. Let your love reach this little one and flow on to the generations after. Amen.

verse: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
prayer: Lord, you are good; your steadfast love endures forever, and your faithfulness to all generations. You were faithful to my parents, you are faithful to me and you will be faithful to {name}. Thank you for faithfulness that does not run out. Let {name} trust it fully, as I am learning to. Amen.

verse: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.
prayer: Father, your mercy is for those who honour you, from generation to generation. Let your mercy rest on our family and reach {name}. Let this little one grow up knowing mercy: being forgiven, loved and given second chances, by you and by us. Let mercy be our family’s heritage. Amen.

verse: “The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
prayer: Lord, the children of your servants shall dwell secure; their offspring shall be established before you. Let {name} dwell secure in you, established and safe. Let our family line be rooted in your presence. Thank you for the promise of security for our children, and for theirs after them. Amen.

verse: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
prayer: Father, I trust in you with all my heart and do not lean on my own understanding. In all my ways I acknowledge you, and you will make my paths straight. Some days I lean too much on books and advice about {name}. Teach me to lean on you first. Make our path straight. Amen.

verse: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
prayer: Lord, those who know your name put their trust in you, for you have not forsaken those who seek you. Let {name} come to know your name: Shepherd, Father, Saviour, Friend. And knowing it, let this little one trust you. Thank you that you never abandon those who look for you. Amen.

verse: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this…
prayer: Father, I commit my way to you and trust in you, and you will act. I commit {name}’s way to you: every step, every year, every choice. I cannot control the path, but I can trust the One who walks it with us. Act on {name}’s behalf, Lord, in your perfect time. Amen.

verse: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
prayer: Lord, I trust in you forever, for you are an everlasting rock. Everything else in {name}’s life will change: friends and homes, interests and seasons, even the shape of our family. But you are the everlasting rock. Let this little one build a whole life on you, the one foundation that never cracks, never shifts and never crumbles. Amen.

verse: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
prayer: Father, some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in your name. I am tempted to trust in money, plans or my own strength to keep {name} safe. Turn my trust to you. Let {name} grow up trusting your name above everything else this world offers. Amen.

verse: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
prayer: Lord, I have trusted in your steadfast love, and my heart rejoices in your salvation. Through these months of caring for {name}, your love has held us, through the hard nights and the glad mornings alike. My heart rejoices. Let {name} grow up rejoicing in you too, with a trust that is joyful and relaxed, not anxious or afraid. Amen.

verse: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
prayer: Father, faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen. I hope for so much for {name} that I cannot yet see: character, faith and a future. Give me faith to be sure of what I hope for. And let {name} grow up with a faith that sees what eyes cannot. Amen.

verse: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
prayer: Lord my God, you have multiplied your wonderful deeds and your thoughts toward us; none can compare with you. If I tried to count them, they would be more than I could number. Today I want to try anyway: {name}’s laugh, those first wobbly stands, every safe night and every answered prayer. Let {name} grow up a counter of blessings, always finding more of your goodness. Amen.

verse: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
prayer: Father, the boundary lines have fallen for us in pleasant places; we have a beautiful inheritance. Our home is not perfect, but it is full of your gifts, and {name} is the brightest of them. Thank you for this family, this place and this season. Let {name} grow up content, grateful for the life you have given and generous with it. Amen.

verse: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
prayer: Lord, you prepare a table before us and anoint our heads with oil; our cup overflows. Sometimes life feels like scraping by, and then I look at {name} and my cup overflows. Thank you for abundance I did not expect: so much love, so much joy, so much growth. Let {name} always know a home where the cup runs over. Amen.

verse: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
prayer: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens; you are the God of our salvation. Every single day of this year you have carried us: the feeds, the worries, the long nights and the busy days. Thank you for daily strength. Keep carrying {name} and me, one day at a time, until this little one is old enough to carry burdens with us. Amen.

verse: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum! If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
prayer: Father, how precious are your thoughts toward us; how vast is the sum of them. If I counted them, they would outnumber the grains of sand. You think about {name} more than I do, and I think about {name} all the time. When I wake in the night and when I wake in the morning, you are still with us both. Amen.

verse: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us…
prayer: Lord, you are able to do far more abundantly than all we ask or imagine, by the power at work within us. I have asked for so much for {name} this year, and you have given more than I imagined. Keep doing more than I can ask. Let {name}’s life be a story of your abundant power and surprising goodness. Amen.

verse: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
prayer: Father, you crown the year with your bounty, and your paths overflow with abundance. As {name}’s first year draws toward its end, I look back and see your bounty everywhere. Thank you for crowning this year with so much goodness. Let the years ahead overflow with your abundance too, for {name} and for our whole family. Amen.

verse: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
prayer: Lord, your words are life to those who find them and healing to their whole body. Let {name} find your words early and live by them. Let your truth bring health to this little body and life to this little soul. As {name} grows and learns new words each week, let your words be among the first and the dearest. Amen.

verse: “I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
prayer: Father, you promise to satisfy those who love you with long life and to show them your salvation. I pray for a long and satisfying life for {name}, full of years and full of you. Let this little one see your salvation in every season, and grow old one day satisfied with your goodness and still trusting your love. Amen.

verse: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
prayer: Lord, a cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones. Thank you for the giggles that fill our home now, for peekaboo and clapping games and the joy {name} finds in simple things. Keep this little heart cheerful. Let laughter be good medicine in our home, healing and strengthening everyone who hears it. Amen.

verse: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
prayer: Father, you promise to bless our bread and our water and to take sickness away from among us. Bless {name}’s food today: the milk, the new tastes and the messy finger foods. Let this little body be nourished and strong. Keep sickness away from our home, and when it does come, let it pass quickly. Amen.

verse: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
prayer: Lord, you sustain the sick on their sickbed and restore them to health. On the days when {name} is unwell, sustain this little one. Restore {name} quickly to full health. And sustain me as I care through sleepless nights and anxious hours. Thank you that you are close to the sick and to those who care for them. Amen.

verse: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
prayer: Father, you promise that as our days are, so shall our strength be. Give {name} strength for every day ahead, matched exactly to what each day brings. Give me strength too, not stored up for weeks, but fresh every morning, just enough for today. Thank you that your strength never runs out. Amen.

verse: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
prayer: Lord, you are my strength and my song; you have become my salvation. You have been my strength through this year with {name}, and you have given me songs even in the hard times. Let {name} grow up with you as strength and song. Let our home be full of strength and music, all pointing back to you. Amen.

verse: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
prayer: Lord, you say, my presence will go with you, and I will give you rest. As we go through this busy season with {name}, let your presence go with us everywhere. To the doctor, to the shops, to visit family and back home again. And wherever we go, give us rest in your presence. Amen.

verse: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you invite us to take your yoke and learn from you, for you are gentle and lowly in heart, and we will find rest for our souls. Teach me your gentleness as I parent {name}. Let me find rest for my soul in you, not just in sleep. Let {name} learn from your gentle heart, too. Amen.

verse: “For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”
prayer: Father, you promise to refresh the weary and satisfy every languishing soul. Some days I feel completely spent: body, mind and heart. Refresh me today. Satisfy my tired soul. Let me be refreshed enough to give {name} my best, and wise enough to accept help when it is offered. Amen.

verse: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
prayer: Lord, return, O my soul, to your rest, for the Lord has dealt bountifully with you. I tell my anxious heart to rest today. You have been so good to {name} and to me this year. Let me remember your bounty and rest in it, rather than running ahead with worry about everything still to come. Amen.

verse: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you told your tired disciples to come away to a quiet place and rest a while, because they had no leisure even to eat. That sounds like parenting a little one! Thank you for caring about our tiredness. Give me small moments of rest today, and give {name} good, deep sleep, so we can both be refreshed. Amen.

verse: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
prayer: Father, there remains a Sabbath rest for your people. Let our family learn to rest well, not just collapse at the end of the day. Teach us healthy rhythms of work and rest. Let {name} grow up in a home that honours rest as a gift from you, not as wasted time. Amen.

verse: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
prayer: Lord, you are the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth; you do not faint or grow weary, and your understanding is unsearchable. When I am weary, you are not. When I do not understand {name}’s needs, you do. Lend me your strength and your understanding today. Amen.

verse: And said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.”
prayer: Lord Jesus, you said that unless we turn and become like little children, we will never enter your kingdom. Watching {name}, I see what you meant: wonder, trust and delight in simple things. Let me learn from my child. Keep {name} childlike in faith all through life, even as wisdom grows. Amen.

verse: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
prayer: Father, teach us to do your will, for you are our God; let your good Spirit lead us on level ground. Teach {name} to do your will from an early age, and let your Spirit lead this little one gently. As {name} starts to understand the word no, give me patience to teach with love. Amen.

verse: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
prayer: Lord, make me know your ways and teach me your paths. I want to know your ways so I can show them to {name}. Teach this little one too: your paths of love, justice and faith. As {name} learns to walk, holding my fingers, let both of us learn to walk in your ways together. Amen.

verse: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
prayer: Father, give instruction to a wise person and that person will be still wiser; teach a righteous person and that person will increase in learning. Let {name} grow up wise and teachable, always willing to learn more. Let this little one never think there is nothing left to learn, especially from you. Amen.

verse: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
prayer: Lord, teach us the way of your statutes, and we will keep it to the end. Teach {name} your ways, and let this child keep them all life long, not just in childhood. Let faith that begins in our home last to the very end. Keep {name} faithful from the first step to the last. Amen.

verse: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
prayer: Father, create in me a clean heart and renew a right spirit within me. As I parent {name}, I see my own heart more clearly: impatience, selfishness, pride. Clean my heart, Lord. Renew my spirit. Let {name} grow up with a parent who is being renewed by you every day. Amen.

verse: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel…
prayer: Lord, let the wise hear and increase in learning, and let the one who understands obtain guidance. Let {name} be a listener and a learner, always seeking guidance from those wiser. Let this little one value good advice and wise teachers. And let me keep learning too, as a parent and as your child. Amen.

verse: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.”
prayer: Father, you created {name} and formed this little one, and you say: do not be afraid, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name; you are mine. Thank you that {name} belongs to you before belonging to anyone else. Let this child hear you calling, mine, at every stage of life, and live without fear because of it. Amen.

verse: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
prayer: Lord Jesus, you call your own sheep by name and lead them out. You know {name} by name. As this little one begins to respond to that name, turning at the sound of my voice, let {name} also learn to recognise your voice. Lead {name} out into a good life, following you closely. Amen.

verse: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
prayer: Father, you have engraved us on the palms of your hands. {name}’s name is written there, never to be rubbed out or forgotten. On the days when I feel I am failing, forgetting appointments and losing track of the little things, I rest in this: my child is always before you, held in your sight and written on your hands. Amen.

verse: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
prayer: Lord, you determine the number of the stars and give to all of them their names. If you name every star, you surely know {name}. Thank you that this little one is not lost in the crowd of billions. You know {name}’s name, face and heart. Let that make {name} feel safe and known. Amen.

verse: “Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
prayer: Lord Jesus, you told your disciples to rejoice most of all that their names are written in heaven. Let {name}’s name be written there. More than any trophy, grade or achievement on earth, let this little one rejoice in belonging to you. Let that be {name}’s deepest joy and the steady ground under every other kind of success or failure. Amen.

verse: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!”
prayer: Father, can a mother forget a nursing child, or feel no compassion for the little one carried for so long? Even if that could happen, you say you will never forget us. As I feed and settle {name}, I feel how impossible it would be to forget this little one. Your love is stronger even than that. Thank you that {name} is never forgotten by you. Amen.

verse: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
prayer: Lord, you call your people a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for your own possession, to proclaim your excellence. Let {name} grow up knowing this identity: chosen, royal, holy and treasured. Let this little one proclaim your goodness, having been called out of darkness into your marvellous light. Amen.

verse: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him. For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
prayer: Father, as a loving parent has compassion on a child, so you have compassion on those who honour you, for you know how we are made and remember that we are dust. You know how frail I am as a parent, how quickly I tire and how often I get things wrong. Thank you for your compassion. Help me to show {name} the same tender mercy you show me. Amen.

verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
prayer: Lord, if we confess our sins, you are faithful and just to forgive us and cleanse us. I confess where I have fallen short with {name} this week: impatience, distraction, unkind words. Forgive me. Cleanse my heart. And let {name} grow up in a home where saying sorry and forgiving are normal. Amen.

verse: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
prayer: Father, as far as the east is from the west, so far you have removed our transgressions from us. Thank you that my parenting mistakes are not held against me forever. Free me from guilt. Let me start fresh with {name} each day. And teach {name} that your forgiveness is that complete. Amen.

verse: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
prayer: Lord, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus. Some days I condemn myself for not being a perfect parent. But you do not condemn me. Let me rest in that freedom. And let {name} grow up free from condemnation, knowing grace runs deeper than failure. Amen.

verse: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
prayer: Father, with you there is forgiveness, that you may be feared. Your forgiveness makes me love and honour you more. Let {name} grow up in awe of how forgiving you are. Let our home be full of forgiveness, and let it lead us all closer to you in wonder and gratitude. Amen.

verse: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.”
prayer: Lord, you say, remember not the former things; behold, I am doing a new thing. Let me not dwell on yesterday’s mistakes with {name}. You are doing new things in our family every day. Let me see them. Let {name} grow up in a home of fresh starts and new mercies. Amen.

verse: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way. Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
prayer: Father, the steps of a person are established by you, and though we fall, we shall not be cast headlong, for you uphold us with your hand. As {name} tries those first wobbly steps and tumbles, I think of my own falls as a parent. Uphold us both. Hold our hands as we learn to walk. Amen.

verse: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
prayer: Lord, two are better than one, for if one falls, the other can help them up. Thank you for the people who help us carry {name}: family, friends, neighbours and church. Let us never parent alone. And let {name} grow up with good friends who lift each other up when they fall. Amen.

verse: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
prayer: Father, a friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity. Give {name} faithful friends who love through every season. Let this little one also be that kind of friend: loyal, kind and present in hard times. Thank you for the friends who have stood by us this year. Amen.

verse: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
prayer: Lord, help us to bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ. Thank you for those who have carried our burdens this year: meals, babysitting, prayers and kind messages. Let {name} grow up with a heart to carry others’ burdens too, seeing need and gently helping. Amen.

verse: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works…
prayer: Father, let us consider how to stir up one another to love and good works. Let {name} grow up in a community that encourages love and goodness. Let this little one have people who spur growth in faith and kindness. And let {name} become that kind of encourager for others too. Amen.

verse: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
prayer: Lord, help us to rejoice with those who rejoice and weep with those who weep. Let {name} grow up with a tender, empathetic heart, glad for others’ joys and gentle with their sorrows. Let our family be the kind that shows up for friends in both happy times and hard times. Amen.

verse: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
prayer: Father, help us to encourage one another and build one another up. Let our home be a building site of encouragement. Let {name} hear encouraging words every day and learn to speak them to others. Build up our family, our friends and our community through the words we share. Amen.

verse: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
prayer: Lord, how good and pleasant it is when people live together in unity. Let our family live in unity, with peace between parents, siblings and grandparents. Let {name} grow up in a home where disagreements are handled with love and where unity is precious. Make our home a good and pleasant place. Amen.

verse: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
prayer: Lord, I will bless you at all times; your praise shall continually be in my mouth. On the easy days and the hard ones, let my mouth praise you. Let {name} grow up hearing praise in our home, morning and evening, in good times and bad. Let praise be the natural language of our family. Amen.

verse: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
prayer: Father, you have put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Thank you for the new songs this year has brought: songs over {name}’s cot, songs of gratitude, songs of relief. Let many see what you have done and trust in you. Let {name} sing new songs too. Amen.

verse: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
prayer: Lord, we sing to you a new song; let all the earth sing to you. Let our home join the song of the whole earth. Let {name} add a small voice to the great chorus of praise. Even now, with babbles and claps, let this little one praise you in a way that delights your heart. Amen.

verse: Both young men and maidens, old men and children. Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
prayer: Father, let young and old, children and grown-ups, praise your name together, for your name alone is exalted. Let every generation in our family praise you side by side: grandparents with their stories, parents with their tired but grateful hearts, and little {name} with claps and squeals. Let our family be a picture of every age praising you as one. Amen.

verse: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
prayer: Lord, you are great and greatly to be praised, and your greatness is beyond searching out. Let {name} grow up amazed by you, always discovering more of who you are. Never let this little one think of you as small, distant or boring. As {name} grows taller and wiser, let wonder and praise grow at the same pace, year after year. Amen.

verse: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
prayer: Father, with all that is within me I bless your holy name. With everything in me, I praise you for {name}. With every part of my heart, I thank you for this year: for the growing, the learning and the love. Let {name} grow up praising you with all that is within, wholehearted and joyful, holding nothing back from the God who holds nothing back. Amen.

verse: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
prayer: Lord, let everything that has breath praise you. {name} has breath, every precious breath a gift from you. Let every breath of this little one become praise. As I listen to {name} breathing in sleep tonight, let it remind me that each breath is a reason to praise. Praise the Lord! Amen.

verse: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
prayer: Lord, your steadfast love never ceases and your mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness. Almost a year of mornings with {name}, and not one of them has come without your mercy. Thank you for fresh starts after hard nights. Let {name} wake every morning of life to mercies that are brand new. Amen.

verse: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
prayer: Father, let me hear of your steadfast love in the morning, for in you I trust. Make me know the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul. As {name} wakes and calls for me, let my first thought be of your love. Show me the way for today, one small decision at a time, for this little one and for me. Amen.

verse: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
prayer: Lord, satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days. Let {name} wake up satisfied with your love, not anxious or empty. Let gladness be the tone of our mornings: smiles over breakfast, songs while dressing, thanks before the day begins. Let joy carry us through all our days. Amen.

verse: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
prayer: Lord, be gracious to us; we wait for you. Be our arm every morning, our salvation in the time of trouble. I need you every single morning, not just on the hard ones. Be {name}’s strength each day, carrying this little one into every new adventure. And be my strength too, as I try to keep up. Amen.

verse: The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.
prayer: Father, you give me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain the weary with a word. Morning by morning you wake me to listen. Teach me each morning what {name} needs to hear: words of love, comfort and encouragement. Let me listen to you first, so I can speak well to my child. Amen.

verse: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
prayer: Lord, I will sing of your strength and of your steadfast love in the morning, for you have been a fortress and a refuge in the day of distress. Thank you for being our fortress this year. Let {name} grow up singing in the mornings, remembering how you have protected and loved our family through every hard day. Amen.

verse: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
prayer: Father, from the rising of the sun to its setting, your name is to be praised. From {name}’s first waking cry to the last sleepy sigh, let our home praise you. Let this little one grow up in a household where praise fills the whole day, from sunrise to sunset, from the first step of life to the last. Amen.

verse: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
prayer: Lord, your angels will bear us up in their hands, so that we will not strike our foot against a stone. As {name} takes first steps, wobbling and falling and getting up again, let your angels be near. Catch this little one when tumbles come. Guard {name}’s feet on every path, in every garden, on every staircase. Amen.

verse: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
prayer: Father, you promise that we will walk on our way securely, and our foot will not stumble. As {name} learns to walk, every step a small adventure, let this little one walk securely. Let {name} grow into confident, steady steps, and later into confident, steady choices, walking securely on your paths. Amen.

verse: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
prayer: Lord, you gave a wide place for my steps under me, and my feet did not slip. Make wide, safe places for {name}’s steps. As this little one explores the world on two wobbly legs, clear the path of danger. Give {name} room to grow, explore and discover, safe within the wide spaces of your care. Amen.

verse: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
prayer: Father, when we walk, our step will not be hampered, and if we run, we will not stumble. I picture {name} running across a garden someday, laughing. Let this little one run freely and not stumble, in body and in life. Let no obstacle hinder {name} from running toward the good things you have planned. Amen.

verse: Who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
prayer: Lord, you have kept our soul among the living and have not let our feet slip. Thank you for keeping {name} alive and well through this whole year. Thank you for every day of health and every danger avoided. Keep {name}’s feet steady in all the years ahead. We praise you for this kept life. Amen.

verse: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
prayer: Father, keep {name}’s steps steady according to your promise, and let no wrong get control over this little life. As {name} learns to walk, let this child also learn to walk in your ways. Guard {name} from habits and influences that would harm. Let your word direct every step of this growing life. Amen.

verse: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
prayer: Lord, I pray {name} will be able to say, my steps have held to your paths; my feet have not slipped. Let this little one stay on your paths through childhood, adolescence and adulthood. When the path is hard or confusing, hold {name}’s feet steady. Let this life be a long walk with you. Amen.

verse: “As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”
prayer: Father, as one whom a mother comforts, so you will comfort us. When {name} falls and cries and runs into my arms, I glimpse how you comfort your children. Thank you for your comfort, gentle, warm and close. Let {name} always know that comfort, from us and above all from you. Amen.

verse: And hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
prayer: Lord, hope does not put us to shame, because your love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit. Pour your love into {name}’s heart, filling it to overflowing. Let this little one never be ashamed of hoping in you. Let your love be the deepest thing {name} knows, steady and sure. Amen.

verse: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”
prayer: Father, the beloved of the Lord dwells in safety; you surround that one all day long and the beloved rests between your shoulders. {name} is your beloved. Let this little one dwell in safety, surrounded by you all day long. Let {name} rest close to you, carried and secure, like a child on a parent’s shoulders. Amen.

verse: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
prayer: Lord Jesus, as the Father has loved you, so you have loved us; you call us to abide in your love. Let {name} abide in your love, staying close and settled there. Let this little one make a home in your love that lasts a lifetime. Help me to abide in your love too, so I can pass it on. Amen.

verse: May be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth, and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
prayer: Father, let {name} have strength to comprehend, with all your people, the breadth and length and height and depth of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge. Let this little one be filled with all your fullness. Let your love be bigger than anything {name} can imagine, and let that love fill every part of life. Amen.

verse: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
prayer: Lord, my soul clings to you, and your right hand upholds me. As {name} clings to me, small fingers gripping tight, let me cling to you in the same way. Uphold me so I can uphold my child. Let {name} grow up clinging to you, held by your strong and loving hand. Amen.

verse: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
prayer: Father, we have come to know and to believe the love you have for us. You are love, and whoever abides in love abides in you, and you abide in them. Let {name} come to know and believe your love. Let this little one abide in love all life long, and in doing so, abide in you. Amen.

verse: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
prayer: Lord, your steadfast love extends to the heavens and your faithfulness to the clouds. As this first year draws to a close, I look up and see how big your love has been. You have been faithful through every day of it. Let {name} grow up looking up, amazed at how high and wide your love and faithfulness reach. Amen.

verse: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us until now.”
prayer: Father, like Samuel I want to set up a stone and say, till now the Lord has helped us. You have helped us through every day of {name}’s first year: every feed, every fever, every sleepless night and every glad morning. This is our Ebenezer. Let {name} grow up knowing that you have helped this family all along the way. Amen.

verse: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
prayer: Lord, I will sing of your steadfast love forever; with my mouth I will make known your faithfulness to all generations. I will sing of what you have done this year, and tell {name} about it again and again. Let this little one make your faithfulness known to the next generation too, singing the same song with a new voice. Amen.

verse: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
prayer: Father, you have blessed us in all the work of our hands; you have known our going through this great wilderness; you have been with us, and we have lacked nothing. Looking back over this year with {name}, I see it: you have been with us, and we have lacked nothing truly needed. Thank you for your faithful presence every step of the way. Amen.

verse: I thank my God whenever I remember you…
prayer: Lord, I thank my God every time I remember {name}. Every memory of this year fills me with gratitude: the first cry, the first smile, the first laugh, the first steps. Thank you for each one. Let {name} grow up knowing that this little life brings deep thanks to your heart and to ours. Amen.

verse: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works. Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
prayer: Father, you have taught us from our youth, and still we proclaim your wondrous deeds. So even to old age and grey hairs, do not forsake us, until we proclaim your might to another generation. Let me live to tell {name} of your goodness, and let {name} live to tell the generation after. Amen.

verse: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds…
prayer: Lord, we give thanks to you always for {name}, as is right, because faith is growing abundantly and love is increasing. Thank you for every bit of growth this year: in body, in heart and in our family. Let {name}’s faith grow abundantly and love increase in the years to come. To you be all the thanks. Amen.

verse: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you. Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
prayer: Lord, at the end of this first year I bring {name} to you with the oldest blessing I know. Bless {name} and keep this child. Make your face shine and be gracious. Lift up your face and give peace. Thank you for every one of these 365 days. Whatever comes next, I place {name} into your hands, where this little one has been all along. Amen.
